history.title: Baseline 1 – sounds and words
history.summary: All letter sounds and short-vowel words, digraphs and blends fine. Gaps: magic e, vowel teams, r-controlled, two-syllable and harder spellings; sight words 27/60 (tier 1 good); spelling 2/10, spells by sound. Got tired by the end.

history.title: Baseline 2 – reading stories
history.summary: Understands everything she reads and hears (10/10). Reads early Year 1 text at 94%, Year 1 text 79% (too hard), slow (13–25 words/min). Misreads magic e, blends and tricky words in sentences.

history.title: Baseline 3 – spelling and writing
history.summary: Spelling 8/18, by sound: uses ck instead of magic e (bick, meack, lick), short u as o (dock), tricky words wrong (sad, wid, wos). Magic e read 1/6. Writes full sentences with capital and full stop, but very slowly on the keyboard; recount was one sentence.

history.title: Training 1 – magic e (a_e, i_e)
history.summary: Magic e clicked: 8/8 hearing, 8/8 reading, 5/5 spelling right after teaching (no ck). said/was/with right first go. Story 95% cold, pace 32 → 39 wcpm. One sentence took 9 minutes to type. Check she remembers next session.

history.title: Training 2 – magic e (o_e, u_e) + want / what / are
history.summary: Remembered magic e cold (4/4 read, 2/2 spell). o_e/u_e 17/17. said/was/with kept; want/what/are 3/3. Story 92% but slow (21 wcpm), 'back' and 'was' still misread. Sentence with 'and' in 3 min. Keyboard ~2 s per letter.

history.title: Training 3 – ai / ay + when / there / put + smooth phrases
history.summary: Remembered o_e/u_e and want/what/are cold. ai/ay 17/17 (hear, read, spell). when/there/put 3/3. Phrases 4/6 smooth. Story 94% at 24 wcpm, 35 after listening. Now sometimes uses the long sound for short words (fun → fine). Done in two sittings.

history.title: Training 4 – ee / ea + long-or-short + could / would / should
history.summary: Remembered ai/ay and when/there/put cold. Long-or-short 8/8 (fun/fine fixed). Phrases 6/6 smooth. ee/ea read 6/6 but which spelling is still shaky (green/grean, sea/see). could/would/should 2/3 first go. Story 92%, 20 → 33 wcpm; 'all' (ball) is a new gap.

history.title: Re-check 1 – everything so far
history.summary: No hints. Reads new magic-e and vowel-team words 12/13 (S1: 1/4). Year 1 story 95% at 21 wcpm (S2: 79% at 13). Free sentence fully correct. But spelling without cues slips back (mack, bic, wid, say: 4/10) and 5 of 12 tricky words aren't instant yet. Reading pace is the main gap.

history.title: Training 5 – choose the pattern + oa / ow + fast tricky words
history.summary: Pattern sort 8/8 and mixed no-cue spelling 6/6 (the re-check gap closed in the session). oa/ow 15/15. Tricky words 10/12 but some slow. Story 96% but 14 wcpm cold. Two-sentence writing came out as one run-on sentence (laik, 'what' for went). 34 minutes: too long again; no recordings (page reloaded).

history.title: Training 6 – all + mixed spelling + two sentences
history.summary: 19 minutes (shorter, as planned). oa/ow remembered cold 4/4. Mixed spelling with no sort first 6/6. 'all' 15/15 (hear, read, spell; bell read correctly). Two separate sentences with full stops ('ate a toast'). Story 97%, 22 → 61 wcpm after listening. Tricky words what and there still not instant.

history.title: Training 7 – reading first + ar + tricky-word families
history.summary: Reading first (her request). Story 100% at 56 wcpm, 71 after listening, but NOT a cold read: parent says she read it several times, with reloads, before the scored read. Mixed spelling with no warm-up dropped to 3/6 (seat 'sit', kite 'kiat', coat 'cote'); sp3 back to learning. New ar 15/15. Three sentences with full stops. Tricky words in isolation 3/6 (when, what, here not yet) but read in the story. Recordings lost (page reloaded). About 38 min elapsed with long pauses; about 20 min of activity.

history.title: Training 8 – reading first + or + which oh
history.summary: True cold story read (1 take): 95%, 20 wcpm; 50 after listening; 'here' read as 'there'. New or 15/15. Which-oh sort 6/6 then road, bone, grow 3/3. ee vs short i by ear 4/6 (seat, feet heard as short). Tricky words in phrases 6/6. Three sentences ('they play', 'ti'). Writing time includes a pause for phone charging. One comprehension answer changed after Back (first try wrong).

history.title: Re-check 2 – everything so far (compare with Session 8)
history.summary: Re-check vs S8: spelling of the same 10 words 9/10 (S8 4/10); tricky words same 12: 10/12 (S8 7/12); new words 11/14 (S8 12/13); ee vs short i 6/6. Cold story DOWN: 91%, 13 wcpm (S8 95%, 21): longer story, two untaught sounds (new, high), and short-vowel blend words (hill → 'hall', strong, stick, spot) missed. Free writing: one long sentence without the frame.

history.title: Year 1 check – phonics screening style, common words, Year 1 spelling
history.summary: 40-word Year 1 check 24/40 (reference: 28 expected by end of Year 1). Section 1 (digraphs, blends) 18/20; section 2 (oi oy ou ow ir ur er ew ue igh ar or) 6/20: ou, ur, ew, ue, igh not yet, and ar/or failed in made-up words. Endings: -ing, -es yes, -ed (wanted) no. Common words 22/30. Spelling 9/12 (8/12 first try): ck/ff/ll/ss and digraphs fine; boxes 'buxes', jumping 'joping', jumped 'juped' (short o/u mix-up). Question mark yes, capital no.

history.title: Training 9 – short vowels + igh + -ed
history.summary: Cold story 92%, 24 wcpm (S13: 13) → 28 after listening. Short-vowel blend words she missed in S13-S14 all read (6/6) and spelled (jump, box, step, hut 4/4); by ear 5/6 (bug → bag). New igh 11/11 and -ed: read 5/6 (rained not), spelled jumped, played. Quick words 5/6 (again not; here 14 s). Writing: two sentences with capitals and full stops, but the second described the picture rather than what happened next.
